name: Bausch Health Companies Inc.
summary: Bausch Health Companies Inc. operates as a diversified specialty pharmaceutical and medical device company. It operates through five segments: Salix, International, Solta Medical, Diversified, and Bausch + Lomb. The company develops, manufactures, and markets products primarily in the therapeutic areas of gastroenterology, hepatology, neurology and dermatology, generic and branded generic pharmaceuticals, dentistry products, over-the-counter products, aesthetic medical devices, and eye health.
